cards.title: Call Tower when number one
cards.leadIn: Do not call while waiting in sequence:

exchange.speaker: Pilot
exchange.text: Navy Corpus Tower, <callsign>, ready for departure, Portland low departure.

exchange.speaker: Tower
exchange.text: <callsign>, Navy Corpus Tower, winds <wind>, cleared for takeoff RWY {from.runway}.

cards.title: Climb out RWY {from.runway} toward PT Silver
instructions: Climb on runway heading to 500' MSL at 200 KIAS
RWY 18: turn left HDG 025°; at 5 DME, turn left HDG 320°
Then fly direct to PT Silver; maintain 500' MSL and 200 KIAS until clear of Class D (4.3 NM), then 240 KIAS

cards.title: Check in with Corpus Departure
cards.leadIn: When directed by Tower, contact Corpus Departure (UHF CH 8):

radio.script: “Corpus Departure, <callsign>, 500 feet off Navy Corpus, Portland Low followed by <VFR intentions>.”
